why: Reads (b) the gradual fill correctly and floats (a) 'savings kept while renting', but also 'cash piling up for a landlord or owner'; never gets (c) idle money. 'The animation doesn't say which.'
Reads houses being erased as housing scarcity, not fog or unknown future: 'homes are scarce and getting scarcer'. Also infers 'buying sooner would beat waiting'.

Mentions 'void, flood or fog' in passing but reads it as housing supply being wiped out: 'a shrinking stock of homes'. Infers waiting to buy won't make it cheaper, then cautions that it says nothing about rent vs buy.
Gets (b) bundles stacking up over time; (a) is ambiguous ('saved money piling up, or money being collected from or paid out around a property'); (c) idle, uninvested cash is not read.
